title: Domain ownership verifier (batch p9-G01-1: P013 domain_ownership correlation rules)
owner: batch p9-G01-1 (v3lum/correlations/ownership.py: domain_ownership, domain_ownership_cnpj_mismatch, domain_ownership_invalid_cnpj, domain_ownership_person)
notes: P013 is a correlation pack over facts already in the graph (no module, no host, no key). Core and sibling names are read, never redefined: registered, cnpj_roots, registrant, registrant_kind, privacy_proxy, created, domain_age_days, rdap_server (rdap; a registrant organisation is registry-vetted only under registro.br, self-declared elsewhere); mx, spf, spf_includes (dns_records / email_security_posture); m365_tenant_id (m365_tenant); tls_certificate (tls_inspect); homepage_indicators (web_archives, P059); site_contacts (P077); legal_name (cnpj_lookup); tags fraud, suspicious, privacy, own_asset, known_good. natural_person is the WP22 correlate.PERSON_TAG, declared here because no fragment declares it yet. cert_organizations is declared here as the certificate-subject fact the rule reads; producers (Cert Spotter cert_der in ct_logs, Censys certificates, tls_inspect) are expected to adopt it.

attributes.cert_organizations: certificate subject organisations seen for a domain [{o, validation EV|OV|IV|DV, names (SAN dNSNames), source, given_name, surname}]: O= only from OV/EV certificates; given_name/surname only from IV certificates (person data, privacy); read by domain_ownership (P013 cond 3)

tags.clone_indicator: the site looks like a copy of another company's site (e.g. a CNPJ displayed that does not match the domain's registrant): a fraud / fake-store lead, never a verdict on its own (P013 cond 4)
tags.ownership: result of the domain ownership verifier (P013): CONFIRMED only from registry or org-profile data, PROBABLE from OV/EV certificate O= (+ tenancy), POSSIBLE = unconfirmed link
tags.org_seed_candidate: CONFIRMED/PROBABLE ownership of a domain the org profile does not list: a `v3lum org seed` proposal that needs analyst confirmation, never an ACTIVE scope entry (P013 cond 7)
tags.natural_person: the correlation links a natural person (P258 cond 3): capped at PROBABLE unless an analyst confirmed it; used by domain_ownership_person (P013 cond 6), tag name of correlate.PERSON_TAG (WP22)
